The use of `exec` is legitimate here, launching the Electron binary with predefined arguments and application code bundled within the package. All paths and values are derived from local, static configuration or environment variables following typical Electron app packaging patterns. There is no evidence of data exfiltration, remote code execution, or tampering with system files.

This script aligns with standard practices for launching sandboxed desktop applications on Linux and poses no supply-chain risk.
